title: Denominator Dash
one_liner: Race the $40T national debt against AI-boosted GDP growth and watch debt-to-GDP rise or collapse.
speaker: Peter Diamandis
context: Elon says only AI and robots can solve the debt. Peter cites $40T in debt, and Jack Clark's projection that GDP grows from $30T to $44T by 2030 against a historic 2–3% per year.
demo: Visitors set a GDP growth slider (2–3% historic vs about 10% per year in the AI case), plus yearly debt growth and a healthcare cost cut. An animated chart races debt against GDP through 2040 and shows the debt-to-GDP ratio as a gauge. Preset buttons load 'historic', 'Anthropic projection' and 'Elon bull case'.
data_plan: Bundled episode figures (debt, yearly increase, GDP today and 2030); all future paths are clearly labeled simulations driven by the sliders
risks: Simplified model with no interest-rate dynamics. Must be labeled illustrative, not a forecast. $2.44T per year works out to about $6.7B a day, slightly above the $6.5B a day stated.
